news_items.headline: Virginia Retirement Systems acquires 29,200 shares of The Allstate Corporation
news_items.summary: Institutional 13F filing disclosed Virginia Retirement Systems added 29,200 shares of ALL. Incremental institutional accumulation.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Piper Sandler and Citi raised price targets on ALL following Q1 2026 results (specific PT figures and exact dates not surfaced in search; treat as recent-but-undated).

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 (reported earlier this period) beat with adj EPS $10.65, revenue $16.9B, 82% combined ratio, $2.7B underwriting income. Co announced 8% dividend increase and $4B buyback. Already priced in; no near-term earnings catalyst before August. Stock hit all-time high $222.23 on 2026-05-05; +1.67% over the last week per search.
